```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

      - name: Parse tag and release info
        id: parse
        run: |
          TAG=${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          MAJOR=$(echo $TAG | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+)\..*/\1/')
          MINOR=$(echo $TAG | sed -E 's/^v[0-9]+\.([0-9]+)\..*/\1/')
          PATCH=$(echo $TAG | sed -E 's/^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.([0-9]+)$/\1/')
          echo "major=$MAJOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "minor=$MINOR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "patch=$PATCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          BRANCH="docs/v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}"
          echo "branch=$BRANCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          RELEASE_NAME="${{ github.event.release.name }}"
          echo "release_name=$RELEASE_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create or update docs branch
        run: |
          git checkout ${{ steps.parse.outputs.tag }}
          git checkout -B ${{ steps.parse.outputs.branch }}
          git push --force origin ${{ steps.parse.outputs.branch }}

      - name: Create Gitbook variant (if patch 0)
        if: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.patch == '0' }}
        env:
          GITBOOK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}
          GITBOOK_SPACE_ID: ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}
        run: |
          VARIANT_NAME="V${{ steps.parse.outputs.major }}.${{ steps.parse.outputs.minor }} - ${{ steps.parse.outputs.release_name }}"
          BRANCH=${{ steps.parse.outputs.branch }}
          echo "Creating variant $VARIANT_NAME for branch $BRANCH"
          curl -s -X POST "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/${GITBOOK_SPACE_ID}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITBOOK_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"name\":\"$VARIANT_NAME\",\"branch\":\"$BRANCH\"}"

      - name: Verify branch exists
        run: |
          git fetch origin ${{ steps.parse.outputs.branch }}:refs/heads/${{ steps.parse.outputs.branch }}
          echo "Branch ${{ steps.parse.outputs.branch }} exists."
```
